notes: Full photo set every epoch (7038), 10+6 epochs, one Colab session. Generator upsample is bilinear, not nearest: the 80-epoch nearest run left a square grid that is not Monet. lambda_cycle 10 (identity 0.5x that). G and D lr both 2e-4; D loss still divided by 2. Save the last epoch. Retrain from scratch; do not load the earlier checkpoint.
